cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: One Thing Leads to Another
cards.instruction: Use each small problem to justify solving a broader, more disruptive problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This caf? chair wobbles. Take it out of service, please; we diagnose the cause before we stuff paper under a leg.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I tested it. It's only this floorboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the chair is a symptom. Lift the boards around it; I need to see the whole support, not one squeak.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then change the opening sign to renovation. With the floor exposed, we can move the counter and fix the queue. Please don't rush a proper solution for the sake of breakfast.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 diagnostic correction, A3 symptom/support distinction and A5 refusal to rush make A expertise drive disruptive scope growth.

heightening.evidence: A5 converts B4 imminent opening into a reason to announce renovation and expand to queue layout.
